name: Prescription digital therapeutics
title: Prescription digital therapeutics after Pear: ripe again?
question: Are prescription digital therapeutics viable again after Pear Therapeutics went bankrupt?
answer: Pear Therapeutics had FDA-authorised apps that doctors prescribed, and filed for bankruptcy in April 2023, saying payers would not reimburse them. Medicare had no code to pay for prescription software. CMS created three: HCPCS G0552-G0554 for digital mental health treatment devices took effect on 1 January 2025, 21 months after Pear filed.
verdict_reason: The payment code that was missing took effect 1 January 2025, and three funded companies died proving demand.

constraint.name: A Medicare payment code for prescription software
constraint.detail: A doctor could prescribe an FDA-authorised app, but Medicare had no billing code for supplying it or managing the patient on it.

crossing.text: CY 2025 Physician Fee Schedule final rule: HCPCS G0552, G0553, G0554 for digital mental health treatment devices.

graveyard.name: Pear Therapeutics
graveyard.how: Chapter 11, 7 April 2023, with a plan to sell its assets

graveyard.name: Akili
